channel.title: TCH Works clothing and mugs
channel.description: Original printed T-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts and mugs, free UK delivery

item.title: Sprouts Not Today T-shirt, Black, XS - Unisex
item.description: An original bold design for anyone who will pass the sprouts along this Christmas, thank you very much. Garment Bella+Canvas 3001 unisex tee, 142 g/m² (4.2 oz) Airlume combed ring-spun cotton (Heather grey is a cotton/polyester blend), side-seamed, retail fit Print Direct-to-garment (DTG) water-based inks on the front. Light colours are printed with a dark-ink version of the design so it stays readable. Sizes XS to 3XL, see the size guide Care Machine wash cold (30°C) inside out, no bleach, tumble dry low or hang dry, do not iron over the print Free UK delivery.

item.description: An original bold design for anyone who will pass the sprouts along this Christmas, thank you very much. Mug 11oz (313 ml) white glossy ceramic mug, about 9.5 cm tall and 8.2 cm across, £14.99. Or 15oz (426 ml) large mug, about 12 cm tall and 8.5 cm across, £17.99: the print stops about 1.5 cm from the rim and base. Print Dye-sublimation, edge to edge, so the design shows on both sides. Mug 11oz (313 ml) white glossy ceramic mug, about 9.5 cm tall and 8.2 cm across, £14.99. Or 15oz (426 ml) large mug, about 12 cm tall and 8.5 cm across, £17.99: the print stops about 1.5 cm from the rim and base. Print Dye-sublimation, edge to edge, so the design shows on both sides. item.title: Got Your Pe Kit? Mug, Classic white - 11oz Ceramic
item.description: An original bold design for the question asked at the front door every single PE day. Mug 11oz (313 ml) white glossy ceramic mug, about 9.5 cm tall and 8.2 cm across, £14.99. Or 15oz (426 ml) large mug, about 12 cm tall and 8.5 cm across, £17.99: the print stops about 1.5 cm from the rim and base. Print Dye-sublimation, edge to edge, so the design shows on both sides. Classic white: dark-ink design on white. Colour wraps (midnight, navy, forest green, berry, blush pink, sky blue): the whole outside is printed in that colour with the design on top; the inside and handle stay white. Care Dishwasher and microwave safe. Hand washing keeps colours brightest for longest. Free UK delivery.

item.description: An original bold design for every commuter who has endured a weekend of engineering works and a very long bus ride. Mug 11oz (313 ml) white glossy ceramic mug, about 9.5 cm tall and 8.2 cm across, £14.99. Or 15oz (426 ml) large mug, about 12 cm tall and 8.5 cm across, £17.99: the print stops about 1.5 cm from the rim and base. Print Dye-sublimation, edge to edge, so the design shows on both sides. Colour wraps (midnight, navy, forest green, berry, blush pink, sky blue): the whole outside is printed in that colour with the design on top; the inside and handle stay white. Care Dishwasher and microwave safe. Hand washing keeps colours brightest for longest. Free UK delivery.

item.description: An original retro design: THE BIG LIGHTS: Switch It Off, UK Tour 1985. A 80s synth-pop band tee made up entirely by us, with no real bands, films or logos. Mug 11oz (313 ml) white glossy ceramic mug, about 9.5 cm tall and 8.2 cm across, £14.99. Or 15oz (426 ml) large mug, about 12 cm tall and 8.5 cm across, £17.99: the print stops about 1.5 cm from the rim and base. Print Dye-sublimation, edge to edge, so the design shows on both sides. Classic white: dark-ink design on white. Colour wraps (midnight, navy, forest green, berry, blush pink, sky blue): the whole outside is printed in that colour with the design on top; the inside and handle stay white. Care Dishwasher and microwave safe. Hand washing keeps colours brightest for longest. Free UK delivery.

Mug 11oz (313 ml) white glossy ceramic mug, about 9.5 cm tall and 8.2 cm across, £14.99. Or 15oz (426 ml) large mug, about 12 cm tall and 8.5 cm across, £17.99: the print stops about 1.5 cm from the rim and base. Print Dye-sublimation, edge to edge, so the design shows on both sides. Classic white: dark-ink design on white. Colour wraps (midnight, navy, forest green, berry, blush pink, sky blue): the whole outside is printed in that colour with the design on top; the inside and handle stay white. Care Dishwasher and microwave safe. Hand washing keeps colours brightest for longest. Free UK delivery.

Drawn by TCH Works, so you will not find it on the high street. Mug 11oz (313 ml) white glossy ceramic mug, about 9.5 cm tall and 8.2 cm across, £14.99. Or 15oz (426 ml) large mug, about 12 cm tall and 8.5 cm across, £17.99: the print stops about 1.5 cm from the rim and base. Print Dye-sublimation, edge to edge, so the design shows on both sides. Classic white: dark-ink design on white. Colour wraps (midnight, navy, forest green, berry, blush pink, sky blue): the whole outside is printed in that colour with the design on top; the inside and handle stay white. Care Dishwasher and microwave safe. Hand washing keeps colours brightest for longest. Free UK delivery.

Drawn by TCH Works, so you will not find it on the high street. Mug 11oz (313 ml) white glossy ceramic mug, about 9.5 cm tall and 8.2 cm across, £14.99. Or 15oz (426 ml) large mug, about 12 cm tall and 8.5 cm across, £17.99: the print stops about 1.5 cm from the rim and base. Print Dye-sublimation, edge to edge, so the design shows on both sides. Classic white: dark-ink design on white. Colour wraps (midnight, navy, forest green, berry, blush pink, sky blue): the whole outside is printed in that colour with the design on top; the inside and handle stay white. Care Dishwasher and microwave safe. Hand washing keeps colours brightest for longest. Free UK delivery.

Pick the age you need from our birthday age range, or personalise any age. Drawn by TCH Works. Mug 11oz (313 ml) white glossy ceramic mug, about 9.5 cm tall and 8.2 cm across, £14.99. Or 15oz (426 ml) large mug, about 12 cm tall and 8.5 cm across, £17.99: the print stops about 1.5 cm from the rim and base. Print Dye-sublimation, edge to edge, so the design shows on both sides. Classic white: dark-ink design on white. Colour wraps (midnight, navy, forest green, berry, blush pink, sky blue): the whole outside is printed in that colour with the design on top; the inside and handle stay white. Care Dishwasher and microwave safe. Hand washing keeps colours brightest for longest. Free UK delivery.
